About this viewer

Ab initio molecular dynamics trajectories (Quantum ESPRESSO, 300 K) of a 1:1 EC:DMC / 1 M LiPF₆ electrolyte, without additive (Reference) and with 5.03 wt% LiBOB (+5 wt% LiBOB).

What you are seeing

  • Coordination number (CN): number of O and F atoms within 2.60 Å of a Li⁺, the first minimum of the Li–O radial distribution function.
  • Dashed purple lines mark these Li⁺ coordination contacts in every frame.
  • Full box shows the whole periodic cell. Li⁺-centred keeps the first solvation shell of one Li⁺ in colour and fades the rest of the box.
  • The panel at the bottom left shows the CN over time and the first-shell composition (EC, DMC, PF₆⁻, BOB⁻) for the current frame.

Controls

  • Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom.
  • Space play / pause · ← → step one frame.
  • Tap legend chips to hide or show a molecule type or element.
